required_environment.built_in_backend: project-owned APIServerService with one shared HTTP process and MemoryStore

capability_scope.worker_restart_durable: shared API/store state survives controller-manager or scheduler worker SIGKILL/restart

optional_environment.RUBERNETES_M3_DURABLE_API_COMMAND: override for a project-owned shared API/store process
optional_environment.RUBERNETES_M3_DURABLE_API_ENDPOINT: HTTP(S) endpoint served by the shared API/store override
optional_environment.RUBERNETES_M3_DURABLE_API_CAPABILITIES: JSON worker-restart capability document for the shared API/store override
optional_environment.RUBERNETES_M3_EFFECT_CHAOS_COMMAND: effect-boundary observer with SIGKILL side-effect controls override

watch_control_response.faults: array containing every requested watch fault
watch_control_response.events: one structured passing observation per fault
